svg.title: Copilot Studio compared with Microsoft Foundry for Cedar agents. Copilot Studio: low-code SaaS, makers such as Dana, channels Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot, Power Platform connectors and Dataverse knowledge, governed by environments and data policies; Cedar Service Assistant XP-08. Microsoft Foundry: code-first on Azure, developers such as Karim, model choice, custom orchestration and multi-agent, evaluations and tracing, Azure identity and networking; Cedar Dispatch Advisor XP-09. Bridge: a Copilot Studio agent can call a Foundry agent, taught in lesson 101.

g.text: Where to build a Cedar agent
Best when speed + M365 reach matter
Omar asks about a site's case history
Code-first on Azure; built by developers (Karim)
Model choice, fine control of prompts
Best when control + custom AI matter
Both can be governed agents; the choice is who builds, where it runs, and how much control is needed.
